status: Steps 6–8 implemented: bounded format normalization and current owner/collection evidence with hybrid search. AI profiles and jobs remain planned.

ownership.tenant: Derived exclusively from the API key.
ownership.registry: Tenant-shared metadata guarded by operation and source grants.
ownership.content: Each record, event, file, run and result belongs to tenant_id + X-User-ID. Schema access does not grant content access.
ownership.received_at: Server UTC time assigned only when an item is first accepted, never supplied by a client.

envelope_semantics.snapshot: record schema; external_id + object_version required; event_id absent; full object payload.
envelope_semantics.upsert: record schema; external_id + object_version + event_id required; full replacement payload, not a partial patch.
envelope_semantics.delete: record schema; external_id + object_version + event_id required; payload must be null.
envelope_semantics.observe: event schema; event_id required; external_id optional; object_version prohibited; object payload. No current-state mutation.
envelope_semantics.versions: Positive integers. Schema versions are explicit and immutable. No implicit latest, coercion, or automatic migration. Record/event version spaces are independent.
envelope_semantics.time: RFC3339 timestamp with offset, normalized to UTC on ingestion. occurred_at is the external fact time; ordering uses object_version, not delivery time.
envelope_semantics.source_sequence: Optional positive integer on changes/observations, unique per tenant+user+collection; stream starts at 1. Snapshots prohibit it. Never inferred from object_version.
envelope_semantics.references: Optional list, at most 20 {collection_id,external_id}; each target must exist and be active under the same owner and an allowed source. observe.external_id additionally links to an active object in the same collection. Semantic external_reference is an external label (e.g. ISBN), not an implicit local link.

pagination.ordering: ascending immutable resource UUID; not a snapshot; concurrent new rows may require restarting enumeration

conventions.filters: Content lists are scoped by collection URL and owner; records support external_id; events additionally support occurred_from (inclusive) and occurred_before (exclusive). Unsupported/repeated query fields return 400.

statuses.400: Malformed DTO, unknown field/query or invalid parameter
statuses.422: Schema, semantic mapping, envelope or payload constraint
statuses.503: Temporary data storage failure; retry identical delivery
statuses.504: Content request exceeded 60 seconds; retry identical deliveries because earlier batch items may have committed.

conventions.rate_limits: Registry and data routes use 120 requests/minute per peer IP per process. RateLimit-* headers; respect RateLimit-Reset. Not a distributed tenant quota.
conventions.compatibility: Existing document/search/query routes retain their request/response bodies. Legacy keys keep legacy:* and catalog:read only. New grants require administrative issuance. Source-restricted keys cannot use unscoped legacy document routes.

batch_ack.atomicity: POST records/events: per-item transactions, at most 100 typed envelopes and 1 MiB. DTO/body failures reject the whole request before writes. Valid DTOs are validated/persisted separately. HTTP 200 alone does not imply every item succeeded.

response.batch_id: UUID for this response, not an idempotency key

batch_ack.retry: Retry failed/unknown items with identical IDs and bodies; duplicate retains original receipt time. 410 is a permanent erasure boundary, never automatically create a new identity. Acknowledgement means committed, not indexed/analyzed.

conventions.idempotency: Registry POST is create-only (409). Ingestion identities: (owner, source, collection, event_id), and (object identity, object_version); a different immutable body conflicts. Time offsets normalize to UTC. JSON key order does not matter. Snapshot and upsert at the same version can share a receipt only when schema, payload, metadata, occurred_at and references agree. A late upsert enriches a snapshot receipt with event identity/sequence. Lower object versions are retained with stale status, without replacing current state. New observations are accepted regardless of occurred_at order.
conventions.schema_migration: Register a new schema version; explicitly transform source payload and send a higher object_version referencing it. Prior versions retain their payload and original schema_version. No automatic reinterpretation or in-place backfill.
conventions.deletion: data:delete permanently erases private payload, metadata, fingerprints and references from current/history rows; retained opaque IDs/versions and erasure fences prevent replay. Referencing records and observation correction chains are erased transitively. DELETE state-event erases its entire object. Collection/source deletes apply only to the current user; registry definitions remain. User delete includes legacy documents/chunks/vectors/knowledge and conversations. Restricted-source keys cannot erase all user data. Existing document writers and query saves are fenced; future workers must recheck fences and evidence versions before commit.
conventions.retention: No automatic expiry in MVP: content remains until explicit deletion. Content-free identity markers/fences persist indefinitely; identities are not reusable. Reconnection requires an explicitly new object/collection/source or user identity outside the erased boundary. Source-side queues/backups/provider retention are owned by their operators; this API erases live application content, not external storage.
conventions.imports: Atomic parts (0..100 snapshots, max 1 MiB), 1-based part <=10000, immutable snapshot_id+boundary+completeness. final declares the last part; out-of-order parts are allowed. Identical part replay returns saved acknowledgements. Reconciliation is read-only and paginated; no absent-object deletion. Source must capture a consistent snapshot plus an opaque change-log cursor and continue delivery after that cursor. API stores the boundary but cannot verify an external log.
conventions.completeness: GET coverage reports source_sequence high watermark, missing ranges (at most 100 + truncation flag), unsequenced events, snapshots and erased receipts. GET import status distinguishes declared completeness from all parts received. history_complete is always false in this MVP; snapshots, contiguous received sequence prefixes and source declarations do not prove complete historical behavior.
conventions.background: Data and data_outbox invalidation are committed in one owner-serialized transaction. No AI calls, indexing worker or scheduled analysis is triggered in step 7. A future worker must re-authorize context and source, reject fences/deleted evidence and compare input versions under the same owner lock before persisting results.

planned_routes.response: 201 immutable profile version; source grants intersect at execution

request.input: persisted selection or explicit one-off payload

planned_routes.response: 200 completed result for sync, 202 run for async; unknown capability/configuration is rejected

future_scopes: data:read, data:write, data:delete are now issuable. Profile/run/result scopes remain planned.

schema_subset.name: paiagent-1
schema_subset.root: Non-nullable object; optional $schema with the exact dialect URI.
schema_subset.objects: properties and additionalProperties:false required; required only references declared properties; names match [A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_-]{0,63}.
schema_subset.nullable: type may be [supported_type,"null"] in either order; absent optional fields are not null values.
schema_subset.arrays: Single items schema required; maxItems 1..100 required; minItems optional.
schema_subset.strings: maxLength 1..16384 required; minLength optional. NUL characters and invalid UTF-8 are rejected.
schema_subset.date_time: Calendar-valid RFC3339 timestamp with explicit offset; no leap seconds.
schema_subset.enums: 1..100 scalar values matching type/constraints; enum on object/array is unsupported.
schema_subset.bounds: Finite numeric bounds with absolute value <= 1e308; lower bound cannot exceed upper bound.
schema_subset.annotations: title/description at most 1000 characters each; structural metadata is tenant-shared, not a private content store.
schema_subset.unsupported: All other keywords, including local/remote $ref, are rejected. No coercion, defaults, dynamic code or remote resolution.

mappings.path: JSON Pointer through object properties only, no arrays/wildcards; missing/null means unavailable.

roles.quantity: number/integer, explicit printable unit label of 1..64 characters; use 1 for dimensionless; no conversion
roles.external_reference: string; singleton, does not confer access to another object
